question.name: The Convert Who Missed Home
question.text: A recently converted Isolan is seen sitting alone, staring toward a familiar part of the island.

a1.text: The villager shares memories of family and old customs. Neighbors offer companionship.

a2.text: The villager admits to fearing rejection. A former rival offers a sincere apology.

a3.text: The villager asks for time alone and later returns to join the others.

b1.text: Working side by side helps old tensions soften.

b2.text: A misunderstanding briefly renews an argument before everyone apologizes.

b3.text: The villager teaches the children a traditional craft, preserving a piece of Isolan history.
